id.instruksi: Dua langkah tertukar tempat: tukar keduanya sekali saja.
id.tubuh-arteri: arteri membawa darah ke seluruh tubuh
id.tubuh-kapiler: di kapiler, oksigen dan sari makanan masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.tubuh-vena: vena membawa darah miskin oksigen kembali ke jantung
id.tubuh-keparu: jantung memompa darah itu ke paru-paru untuk mengambil oksigen lagi
id.paru-pompa: jantung memompa darah miskin oksigen ke paru-paru
id.paru-ambil: di paru-paru, darah melepas karbon dioksida dan mengambil oksigen
id.paru-kembali: darah kaya oksigen kembali ke jantung
id.paru-ketubuh: jantung memompanya lewat arteri ke seluruh tubuh
id.paru-kapiler: di kapiler tubuh, oksigen masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.otak-arteri: arteri di leher membawa darah naik ke otak
id.otak-kapiler: di kapiler otak, oksigen dan sari makanan masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.otak-vena: vena di leher membawa darah turun dari otak
id.lari-mulai: kamu berlari, otot kaki butuh lebih banyak oksigen
id.lari-cepat: jantung berdetak lebih cepat dan lebih kuat
id.lari-arteri: arteri membawa lebih banyak darah ke otot kaki
id.lari-kapiler: di kapiler otot kaki, oksigen masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.lari-vena: vena membawa darah kembali ke jantung
id.katup-pompa: jantung memompa darah kaya oksigen ke kaki
id.katup-arteri: arteri membawa darah turun sampai telapak kaki
id.katup-kapiler: di kapiler telapak kaki, oksigen masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.katup-naik: otot betis memeras vena dan katupnya menahan darah, jadi darah naik ke jantung
id.ginjal-arteri: arteri ginjal membawa darah ke ginjal
id.ginjal-saring: ginjal menyaring sisa zat dan air berlebih dari darah
id.ginjal-vena: darah yang sudah bersih keluar lewat vena ginjal
id.ginjal-tiba: vena besar membawa darah itu kembali ke jantung
id.usus-arteri: arteri membawa darah ke dinding usus
id.usus-serap: di kapiler usus, darah menyerap sari makanan
id.usus-hati: vena membawa darah kaya sari makanan ke hati
id.usus-tiba: dari hati, darah mengalir kembali ke jantung
id.koroner-pompa: jantung memompa darah kaya oksigen ke aorta
id.koroner-arteri: arteri koroner membawa sebagian darah ke otot jantung
id.koroner-kapiler: di kapiler otot jantung, oksigen masuk ke sel, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.koroner-vena: vena jantung mengumpulkan darah miskin oksigen
id.koroner-tiba: darah itu masuk kembali ke dalam jantung
id.parupanjang-tukar: di kapiler paru-paru, karbon dioksida dilepas dan oksigen diambil
id.parupanjang-venaparu: vena paru-paru membawa darah kaya oksigen
id.s-oksigen: Oksigen dari udara sampai ke otot
id.oksigen-hirup: kamu menghirup udara, oksigen masuk ke paru-paru
id.oksigen-masuk: di kapiler paru-paru, oksigen masuk ke darah
id.oksigen-venaparu: vena paru-paru membawa darah kaya oksigen ke jantung
id.oksigen-pompa: jantung memompa darah itu lewat arteri ke otot lengan
id.oksigen-sel: di kapiler otot lengan, oksigen masuk ke sel otot
id.karbon-buat: sel otot memakai oksigen dan menghasilkan karbon dioksida
id.karbon-masuk: di kapiler, karbon dioksida masuk ke darah
id.karbon-vena: vena membawa darah itu ke jantung
id.karbon-embus: di paru-paru, karbon dioksida dilepas dan diembuskan keluar

en.instruksi: Two steps have swapped places: swap them back with one move.
en.tubuh-arteri: arteries carry blood around the body
en.tubuh-kapiler: in the capillaries, oxygen and nutrients pass into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.tubuh-vena: veins carry oxygen-poor blood back to the heart
en.tubuh-keparu: the heart pumps that blood to the lungs to pick up oxygen again
en.paru-pompa: the heart pumps oxygen-poor blood to the lungs
en.paru-ambil: in the lungs, blood drops carbon dioxide and picks up oxygen
en.paru-kembali: oxygen-rich blood returns to the heart
en.paru-ketubuh: the heart pumps it through the arteries around the body
en.paru-kapiler: in the body capillaries, oxygen passes into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.otak-arteri: arteries in the neck carry the blood up to the brain
en.otak-kapiler: in the brain capillaries, oxygen and nutrients pass into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.otak-vena: veins in the neck carry the blood down from the brain
en.otak-tiba: the blood arrives back at the heart
en.lari-mulai: you run, and your leg muscles need more oxygen
en.lari-cepat: the heart beats faster and harder
en.lari-arteri: arteries carry more blood to the leg muscles
en.lari-kapiler: in the leg muscle capillaries, oxygen passes into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.lari-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.s-katup: Blood climbs up from the feet
en.katup-pompa: the heart pumps oxygen-rich blood to the legs
en.katup-arteri: arteries carry the blood all the way down to the feet
en.katup-kapiler: in the capillaries of the feet, oxygen passes into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.katup-vena: the blood enters the leg veins
en.katup-naik: calf muscles squeeze the veins and their valves hold the blood, so it climbs back to the heart
en.s-ginjal: Blood is cleaned in the kidneys
en.ginjal-arteri: the renal artery carries blood to the kidneys
en.ginjal-saring: the kidneys filter waste and extra water out of the blood
en.ginjal-vena: the cleaned blood leaves through the renal vein
en.ginjal-tiba: a large vein carries that blood back to the heart
en.usus-arteri: arteries carry blood to the wall of the intestine
en.usus-serap: in the intestine capillaries, blood soaks up nutrients
en.usus-hati: a vein carries the nutrient-rich blood to the liver
en.usus-tiba: from the liver, the blood flows back to the heart
en.s-koroner: Blood for the heart muscle itself
en.koroner-pompa: the heart pumps oxygen-rich blood into the aorta
en.koroner-arteri: the coronary arteries carry some of the blood to the heart muscle
en.koroner-kapiler: in the heart muscle capillaries, oxygen passes into cells and carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.koroner-vena: the heart veins collect the oxygen-poor blood
en.koroner-tiba: that blood flows back inside the heart
en.parupanjang-arteri: the pulmonary artery carries it to the lungs
en.parupanjang-tukar: in the lung capillaries, carbon dioxide is let go and oxygen is picked up
en.parupanjang-venaparu: the pulmonary vein carries oxygen-rich blood
en.parupanjang-tiba: the blood arrives back at the heart
en.s-oksigen: Oxygen from the air to a muscle
en.oksigen-hirup: you breathe in, and oxygen enters the lungs
en.oksigen-masuk: in the lung capillaries, oxygen passes into the blood
en.oksigen-venaparu: the pulmonary vein carries the oxygen-rich blood to the heart
en.oksigen-pompa: the heart pumps that blood through the arteries to the arm muscles
en.oksigen-sel: in the arm muscle capillaries, oxygen passes into the muscle cells
en.karbon-buat: muscle cells use oxygen and make carbon dioxide
en.karbon-masuk: in the capillaries, carbon dioxide passes into the blood
en.karbon-vena: veins carry that blood to the heart
en.karbon-pompa: the heart pumps it to the lungs
en.karbon-embus: in the lungs, carbon dioxide is let go and breathed out
